technique_name: Explain why using unrealistic data sets in AI-based tasks can lead to inaccurate results.
description: Using unrealistic data sets in AI-based tasks can lead to inaccurate results because AI-based systems are designed to analyze data in order to make predictions and generate insights. If the data is not representative of the real world, then the AI-based system may not be able to effectively identify patterns and trends in the data which can lead to inaccurate results.
